evals.prompt: design the cache layer for our CLI — we keep re-fetching the same registry metadata on every run. I'm torn between sqlite and a flat-file json cache, maybe there's a third option. walk me through tradeoffs and land on one.
evals.expected_output: Plan-mode propose-then-critique loop over named alternatives; approved plan handed to github ISSUE with a class label; SPEC.md untouched; no designs/ file.
expectations: The run enters plan mode (EnterPlanMode) before proposing
The plan names the alternatives (sqlite, flat-file json, and any third option raised) and records a decision
The plan's Open Questions section is empty or absent when ExitPlanMode is called
After approval, a GitHub issue is created whose body carries a '## Acceptance' checklist and a class label
No file is written under designs/
SPEC.md is byte-identical before and after the run
The final response ends with a '## Next' block whose first item is /sdd:spec github issue N
